announcements.headline: Subsea7 awarded contract extension offshore N...
announcements.insight: Subsea7 awarded contract extension offshore N... follows its November 2026 US contract win. This indicates continued operational activity post-combination approval.

announcements.headline: Subsea 7 - awarded contract offshore US
announcements.insight: Subsea 7 was awarded an offshore US contract. This follows the CADE approval of the Subsea7 and Saipem combination in November 2026.

announcements.headline: Subsea7 - Sale of heavy transportation business
announcements.insight: Subsea7 disposes of its heavy transportation business following CADE approval of the Subsea7 and Saipem combination in November. This sale represents a material strategic shift post-merger.

announcements.headline: Subsea 7 - CADE Approves the Combination of Subsea7 and Saipem
announcements.insight: Subsea7 SA shareholders face a transformative merger as CADE approves the combination with Saipem. This regulatory clearance is a critical step in finalizing the deal.
